name: LIHEAP
description: One-time payment to help pay heating or cooling bills, emergency help to avoid disconnection, and energy efficiency improvements and energy-related home repairs; funding is limited and agencies prioritize the most vulnerable households
fullDescription: The Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) is a federally funded program that helps low-income households pay their energy bills and make energy-efficient home improvements.
whatTheyOffer:
- One-time payment toward your heating or cooling bill
- Emergency help if your utility is about to be shut off
- Energy efficiency improvements (weatherization)
- Energy-related home repairs
- Assistance with heating and cooling costs
howToGetIt:
1. Find your local LIHEAP provider with the search tool on the CSD website
2. Check income eligibility (2026 limit is about $3,332/month for 1 person, higher for larger households)
3. Gather documents: ID, utility bills, income verification
4. Apply through your local LIHEAP agency
5. If approved, payment goes directly to your utility company
keywords: LIHEAP, energy bill, utility assistance, low-income, heating, cooling, weatherization, disconnection, crisis assistance, federal
